name: Inmate Boyfriend
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve tied-back locs, slate/white striped uniform with existing 12345 badge, dark boots, coiled-cord phone and photo props. Review one phone/cord topology, shield geometry and distance handoff; no extra readable text beyond existing badge and move title.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words; preserve only the existing uniform number 12345. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Inmate Boyfriend — Looking Out.
IDENTITY: exact athletic adult brown-skinned man, shaved side pattern and long dark locs tied in a high ponytail, slate-blue-and-white striped short-sleeve uniform and matching trousers, existing chest number 12345, heavy black lace-up boots. Preserve his dark navy corded push-button telephone and black spiral cable. Keep the reference's small white-bordered portrait photographs as paper props, not additional living people. Preserve recognizable face and outfit.
0–0.7s: establish full body as he catches two loose photographs, looks between them with confident focus, and tucks them safely behind the telephone handset held in his left hand. The phone's navy base hangs from its long black coiled cord in his right.
0.7–2.4s: he whips the phone base through one immense overhead loop. Camera pulls way back as the spiral cord stretches into an enormous protective oval around him and the photographs. Three heavy charcoal cartoon weights descend toward the oval, bounce off the spring-loaded cord and fly away into the distance in three accelerating elastic rebounds. The last rebound launches the navy phone base far forward. One dominant orange/ivory impact star at the final deflection, finite disconnected speed strokes, clear cyan between the cord loops. No walls, bars, cell, floor or other scenery.
2.4–3.4s: camera chases the speeding phone base down its long cable until it reaches a second small floating packet of photographs far away. The base swings under that packet like a protective catcher's mitt, cups it safely, then the cable retracts and brings both back to his open hand. Make this one continuous connected phone cord with a clear long-distance save, not extra phones or tangled limbs. Exact title LOOKING OUT slams beneath his face as the camera returns.
3.4–5s: readable full-body hero hold. He stacks all photographs neatly, then lifts the handset with a proud half-smile. The navy phone base gives one absurdly loud final RING; he startles with a tiny shoulder jump, then regains his cool. Existing uniform number remains, no new labels or speech. SFX: photo flick, cable whip, three springy protective rebounds, dominant metallic BOING, distant catch click, rapid cable zip, title impact, one loud telephone ring. No dialogue or music.
